o.text: From Turkish özelleştirmek. By surface analysis, özəlləşmək + -dir.
From Persian تلاش, itself borrowed from a Turkic source.
Probably from a word derived from Arabic ع ر ق ل (ʕ r q l, root), possibly influenced by Persian انگل (angal).
Likely a calque of Classical Persian خدا رحمت کنه (xudā rahmat kuna, literally “may Lord show them mercy”).
